body: My wife downloaded this app thinking it was free for 6 months. Now today I’m going through her phone and she has a subscription weekly for $10. Auto renews every week also it’s way cheaper to go monthly or yearly, this is way to predatory. There are better ways to handle free trials than how they do. The fact that she tried to use this app and it didn’t work and was not aware she signed up for weekly renewals. She just didn’t use it and it auto charged. Just be aware that there are better apps and not ones with horrible pricing setups ment to trick people. I sent an email to the company and I will adjust my review when I hear back in regards to my inquiry.
